name: kanopi/firewall-laravel
description: Laravel integration for kanopi/firewall: middleware, config, Artisan commands and event wiring.

suggest.laravel/octane: Supported, with one caveat worth reading: see the Octane section of the README before you enable persist_instance.
suggest.ext-redis: Required by the firewall's Redis storage and Redis rate-limit backends, for a block list shared across more than one server.

scripts-descriptions.phpunit:coverage: Run both suites in a single pass with coverage. Coverage MUST be measured across both suites: the middleware and the service provider are only exercised end to end by the feature suite, and the unit suite alone understates them badly.
scripts-descriptions.test:gate: Alias for phpunit:coverage — the run the CI coverage gate reads
scripts-descriptions.test:install: Install the package into a freshly created Laravel application and drive it over HTTP. Slow (it runs composer create-project) and the only test that exercises Composer discovery, vendor:publish, real file storage and the cli-server SAPI — the four things Testbench cannot.
scripts-descriptions.test:matrix: Run the suite against every supported PHP and Laravel combination in Docker. Slow, and the only way to check a PHP version this machine does not have installed — it is what produced the support table in the README.
scripts-descriptions.check:coverage-driver: Fail with an explanation when no coverage driver is loaded. Without it PHPUnit reports "No tests executed!", which names the symptom rather than the missing extension — the first CI run on this repository failed that way in seven jobs.
scripts-descriptions.test:ci: Run a CircleCI job's own commands inside the image CI uses, before pushing. The first two pipelines on this repository each failed on a different fault in the CI config, one per push — this is the loop that catches them in one pass instead.
